dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is a cryptocurrency based on a 2013 meme. As of today, it’s a way to pay for tickets and merchandise for the N.B.A.’s Dallas Mavericks. The transactions will be processed by the crypto payments company BitPay, which has handled Bitcoin purchases for the Mavs since 2019.
Oakland A’s fans purchased two seats with 100 Dogecoin — making MLB history. As of this morning, the cryptocurrency hit another record high
